import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 10000000;
    static final int MAX = 12;
    static final int MAX_T = 62;
    static final int MAX_N = 210;
    static final int MAX_E = 21000;

    static class Edge {
        int target;
        int capacity;
        Edge(int t, int c) { target = t; capacity = c; }
    }

    static Edge[] edges = new Edge[MAX_E];
    static int[] adj_index = new int[MAX_E];
    static int[] head = new int[MAX_N];
    static int edge_cnt = 0;

    static void insert(int u, int v, int w) {
        edges[edge_cnt] = new Edge(v, w);
        adj_index[edge_cnt] = head[u];
        head[u] = edge_cnt++;

        edges[edge_cnt] = new Edge(u, 0);
        adj_index[edge_cnt] = head[v];
        head[v] = edge_cnt++;
    }

    static int[] dist = new int[MAX_N];
    static int[] qbuf = new int[MAX_N * 2];
    static int[] arc = new int[MAX_N];
    static int[] gap = new int[MAX_N];
    static int[] inq = new int[MAX_N];
    static int[] prev_ver = new int[MAX_N];

    static int dinic(int s, int t) {
        Arrays.fill(arc, -1);
        Arrays.fill(prev_ver, -1);
        int qf = 0, qr = 0;
        qbuf[qr++] = t;
        inq[t] = 1;
        gap[0]++;
        dist[t] = 0;

        while (qf < qr) {
            int u = qbuf[qf++];
            for (int i = head[u]; ~i != 0; i = adj_index[i]) {
                int v = edges[i].target;
                if (inq[v] == 0) {
                    qbuf[qr++] = v;
                    inq[v] = 1;
                    dist[v] = dist[u] + 1;
                    gap[dist[v]]++;
                    arc[v] = head[v];
                }
            }
        }

        int flow = 0, min_cap = INF;
        int u = s;
        prev_ver[s] = s;

        while (dist[s] < t) {
            boolean found = false;
            for (int i = arc[u]; ~i != 0; i = adj_index[i]) {
                if (edges[i].capacity > 0 && dist[edges[i].target] + 1 == dist[u]) {
                    found = true;
                    min_cap = Math.min(min_cap, edges[i].capacity);
                    prev_ver[edges[i].target] = u;
                    u = edges[i].target;
                    if (u == t) {
                        int delta = min_cap;
                        while (u != s) {
                            u = prev_ver[u];
                            edges[arc[u]].capacity -= delta;
                            edges[arc[u]^1].capacity += delta;
                        }
                        flow += delta;
                        min_cap = INF;
                    }
                    break;
                }
            }

            if (found) continue;

            int min_dist = t + 1;
            for (int i = head[u]; ~i != 0; i = adj_index[i]) {
                if (edges[i].capacity > 0 && min_dist > dist[edges[i].target]) {
                    min_dist = dist[edges[i].target];
                    arc[u] = i;
                }
            }

            gap[dist[u]]--;
            if (gap[dist[u]] == 0) return flow;
            dist[u] = min_dist + 1;
            gap[dist[u]]++;
            u = prev_ver[u];
        }

        return flow;
    }

    static char[][] grid1 = new char[MAX][MAX];
    static char[][] grid2 = new char[MAX][MAX];
    static int[][] sci = new int[MAX][MAX];
    static int[][] cap = new int[MAX][MAX];
    static int[][][] fire = new int[MAX_T][MAX][MAX];
    static int[][][][][] reach = new int[MAX_T][MAX][MAX][MAX][MAX];
    static int[][] dirs = {{-1,0},{1,0},{0,-1},{0,1}};
    static int size, limit;

    static void propagate() {
        for (int k = 1; k <= limit; ++k) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= size; ++i) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= size; ++j) {
                    if (fire[k-1][i][j] == 1) {
                        fire[k][i][j] = 1;
                    } else if (fire[k-1][i][j] == 2) {
                        fire[k][i][j] = 2;
                    } else {
                        for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                            int ni = i + dirs[d][0], nj = j + dirs[d][1];
                            if (ni >= 1 && ni <= size && nj >= 1 && nj <= size) {
                                if (fire[k-1][ni][nj] == 2) {
                                    fire[k][i][j] = 2;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static boolean[][] visited = new boolean[MAX][MAX];

    static void trace(int sx, int sy, int x, int y, int k) {
        visited[x][y] = true;
        reach[k][sx][sy][x][y] = 1;
        if (k >= limit || fire[k][x][y] != 0) return;
        for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
            int nx = x + dirs[d][0], ny = y + dirs[d][1];
            if (nx >= 1 && nx <= size && ny >= 1 && ny <= size && !visited[nx][ny]) {
                if (fire[k][nx][ny] != 0) continue;
                trace(sx, sy, nx, ny, k + 1);
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        
        size = sc.nextInt();
        limit = sc.nextInt();
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= size; ++i) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int j = 1; j <= size; ++j) {
                grid1[i][j] = line.charAt(j-1);
                if (grid1[i][j] == 'Z') fire[0][i][j] = 2;
                else if (grid1[i][j] == 'Y') fire[0][i][j] = 1;
                else sci[i][j] = grid1[i][j] - '0';
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= size; ++i) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int j = 1; j <= size; ++j) {
                grid2[i][j] = line.charAt(j-1);
                if (grid2[i][j] >= '0' && grid2[i][j] <= '9') {
                    cap[i][j] = grid2[i][j] - '0';
                }
            }
        }

        propagate();

        for (int i = 1; i <= size; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= size; ++j) {
                if (sci[i][j] != 0) {
                    for (int x = 0; x < MAX; ++x) Arrays.fill(visited[x], false);
                    trace(i, j, i, j, 0);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int k = 1; k <= limit; ++k) {
            for (int x = 1; x <= size; ++x) {
                for (int y = 1; y <= size; ++y) {
                    for (int nx = 1; nx <= size; ++nx) {
                        for (int ny = 1; ny <= size; ++ny) {
                            reach[k][x][y][nx][ny] += reach[k-1][x][y][nx][ny];
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        int src = 0, dst = size * size * 2 + 1;
        Arrays.fill(head, -1);
        edge_cnt = 0;

        for (int i = 1; i <= size; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= size; ++j) {
                insert(src, (i-1)*size + j, sci[i][j]);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= size; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= size; ++j) {
                insert(size*size + (i-1)*size + j, dst, cap[i][j]);
            }
        }

        for (int x = 1; x <= size; ++x) {
            for (int y = 1; y <= size; ++y) {
                for (int nx = 1; nx <= size; ++nx) {
                    for (int ny = 1; ny <= size; ++ny) {
                        if (sci[x][y] != 0 && cap[nx][ny] != 0 && reach[limit][x][y][nx][ny] != 0) {
                            insert((x-1)*size + y, size*size + (nx-1)*size + ny, INF);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(dinic(src, dst));
    }
}
